name: Public Health Birth Data: Pregnancy Health and Risk Factors
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Source data does not differentiate between gender and sex assigned at birth. For clarity and brevity, metadata descriptions reflect gendered language with the understanding that these descriptions may not accurately reflect all cases.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Place
columns.description: CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Race and Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of mother. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic". "PI" refers to "Pacific Islander".

columns.name: Count of Alcohol Consumption
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who consumed alcohol during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Alcohol Consumption
columns.description: Number of births to mothers who consumed alcohol during pregnancy per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Diabetes
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers diagnosed with diabetes during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Diabetes
columns.description: Number of births to mothers with diabetes or gestational diabetes per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Hypertension
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers diagnosed with hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Hypertension
columns.description: Number of births to mothers with hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Smoking
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who smoked one or more cigarettes during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Smoking
columns.description: Number of births to mothers who smoked one or more cigarettes during pregnancy per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Low Weight Gain
columns.description: Total number of births where the mother gained less than 25 pounds during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Low Weight Gain
columns.description: Number of births with maternal weight gain less than 25 Ibs per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Inadequate Prenatal Care
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers who received inadequate prenatal care based on timing or number of visits

columns.name: Rate of Inadequate Prenatal Care
columns.description: Number of births to mothers with prenatal care beginning after third month of pregnancy or no prenatal care received per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Other Risks
columns.description: Total number of births to mothers with one or more medical risk factors (including HIV-positive, diabetes, high blood pressure) during pregnancy

columns.name: Rate of Other Risks
columns.description: Number of births to mothers with one or more medical risk factors (including HIV-positive, diabetes, high blood pressure) per 100 live births
